note: Modules generated from xls/*.x. See doc/xls.md. Every module is scheduled by XLS against the asap7 delay model at the same 1300 ps target; stage counts are the minimum that meets it, measured with `make xls-report`.

release.note: The pinned XLS distribution. tools/xls/fetch_xls.sh downloads it, verifies this sha256 BEFORE unpacking, and puts it in <repo>/.xls/cur. R1-09 allows a public tool distribution with a fixed checksum and forbids treating an unverified local cache or a floating tag as a locked version.

local.note: Where xlsgen.py looks for a local install, after $XLS_HOME. A local runner is the only one R1_STRICT=1 accepts.

remote.note: Development convenience only: XLS publishes linux-x64 binaries and this is developed on macOS arm64. R1_STRICT=1 refuses this runner, because a personal SSH host and a private key are not a locked generator (R1-09).

modules.why: All-pairs conversion among the five formats: a widen and a narrow in series, which is why it needs one more stage than narrow alone. This is the timing-driven instance, for a context with a clock of its own.

The same conversion, unpipelined, for the sixteen lanes of tnca_vector_fpu. That unit's clock is set by its FMA at 115 gate levels and the convert chain is 54, so pipelining it there would add 253 flops per lane to buy timing the unit cannot use. One DSLX description, two implementations, both checked by tb_cvt_xls against the same oracle.

Narrow format to binary32. Exact by construction, so no rounding logic, and its 1005 ps asap7 path fits the 1300 ps target with no flops at all -- which is what lets tnca_fpu_multi put it in front of the FMA without adding a cycle.
binary32 to a narrow format. This half carries the rounding, saturation and subnormal generation for four target formats, and is 3476 ps combinational, so it is the half that has to be pipelined.
Widen two narrow operands to binary32 for the matrix unit. No arithmetic: apfloat flushes subnormals and this ISA does not. Combinational for the same reason as tnca_widen_xls.
SFU exp2: table-indexed quadratic, ISA sec 8.8 bound 2^-22.
SFU log2: table-indexed quadratic, ISA sec 8.8 bound 2^-22.
SFU rcp: table-indexed quadratic, ISA sec 8.8 bound 2^-22. Seven stages, not the six this one alone needs, so all four SFU operations share a latency.
SFU rsqrt: table-indexed quadratic, ISA sec 8.8 bound 2^-22. Seven stages, not the six this one alone needs, so all four SFU operations share a latency.

First stage of the latency-2 binary32 FMA (FP_LAT = 2, the image's): unpack, classify, the 24x24 product, the exponent difference and the alignment shift with its sticky bit. Combinational: rtl/core/tnca_fp32_fma.v registers its FmaAligned result. R41 Stage 2 (F03/F08/F09) places the two cuts of this instance by hand, at the points the U280 measures as balanced -- after the alignment shift and after the leading-zero count -- because asap7, which the XLS schedule balances against, prices the 24x24 multiplier that the FPGA maps to two DSP48E2 slices at several times its FPGA cost and so moved the alignment shifter into the middle stage. The arithmetic of each stage is still generated from the one DSLX function, xls/tnca_fma.x, and fma32 is the three stages composed.

Second stage of the latency-2 FMA: add or subtract the aligned operands (the sticky borrow carry-selected), count leading zeros, and every quantity that follows the count. Combinational; registered by rtl/core/tnca_fp32_fma.v.

Third stage of the latency-2 FMA: the normalising shift, round to nearest even (carry-select) and assembly. Combinational into the consumer's register (the vector writeback, the accumulator file), as the generated three-stage instance's last stage was: latency 2, a result every cycle, the same FP_LAT and the same cycles.

The same FMA one stage deeper (four stages, three registers: latency 3), for a faster clock: selected by FP_LAT=3 through tnca_fp32_fma. Scheduled by XLS from fma32, the three stage functions composed. The matrix unit's accumulate interleave (16 rows) and the vector FPU's reduction sequencer both take any FP_LAT up to 15.

R41 packed dot-product lane, FEASIBILITY PROTOTYPE (evidence/r41/pmac/lane): not instantiated by the core. The binary32 FMA's first stage from its multiplier's output on: the addend, the exponent difference and the alignment shift with its sticky bit, for any product (FmaProduct). fma32_align is fma32_mul composed with it. Combinational; rtl/core/tnca_pmac_lane.v uses it so a register can sit between a product front end and the alignment.

R41 packed dot-product lane, FEASIBILITY PROTOTYPE (evidence/r41/pmac/lane): not instantiated by the core. V1 front end, first half: binary32 product (fma32_mul) and the DP4 group sum of four exact FP8 products (all four E4M3/E5M2 pairs) in a 66-bit fixed-point field. Combinational.

R41 packed dot-product lane, FEASIBILITY PROTOTYPE (evidence/r41/pmac/lane): not instantiated by the core. V2 front end, first half, products in LUTs: binary32 product, the DP4 sum, and the DP2 sum (two exact 11x11 products, aligned with a sticky bit). Combinational.

R41 packed dot-product lane, FEASIBILITY PROTOTYPE (evidence/r41/pmac/lane): not instantiated by the core. V2 front end, first half, DSPs shared: the binary32 24x24 product as two 24x12 products (P + Q<<12, the second DSP's post-adder), each DSP taking one 11x11 product in DP2 mode; the DP4 sum in LUTs. Combinational.

R41 packed dot-product lane, FEASIBILITY PROTOTYPE (evidence/r41/pmac/lane): not instantiated by the core. V1/V2 front end, second half: |sum|, RO_48 (18-bit leading-zero count, right shift 0..18, OR into the last bit) and the mode's product select. Combinational.

R41 packed dot-product lane, FEASIBILITY PROTOTYPE (evidence/r41/pmac/lane): not instantiated by the core. V3 front end, first half: binary32 product and the E4M3-only DP4 sum in a 38-bit field (exact, at most 38 significant bits). Combinational.

R41 packed dot-product lane, FEASIBILITY PROTOTYPE (evidence/r41/pmac/lane): not instantiated by the core. V3 front end, second half: |sum| as an unnormalised 48-bit product (RO_48 is the identity for E4M3) and the mode's select. Combinational.

R41 G2 FMA rebuild (evidence/r41/hbm_bw/fma_dslx): the binary32 FMA's second stage with the 89-bit leading-zero count as a balanced tree (xls/tnca_lzc.x) instead of the stdlib clz, proved equal to tnca_fma::fma32_normalise for every input (prove_quickcheck normalise_equiv). Used by tnca_fp32_fma IMPL=1 (default 0) and by tnca_mac_lane. Combinational.

R41 G2 FMA rebuild: tnca_fma_l3_xls's function (fma32d = fma32 with the tree leading-zero count, its normalise proved equal) scheduled the same way, four stages, for tnca_fp32_fma IMPL=1 at LAT 3 (default IMPL 0).

R41 G2 shared multi-precision MAC lane (evidence/r41/hbm_bw/fma_dslx): default-off (tnca_matrix MAC_DP). S1: decode, the binary32 product (fma32_mul), the E4M3 DP4 group sum as a fixed-point DSP cascade, the two DP2 products and the choice of the reference product. Combinational.

R41 G2 shared multi-precision MAC lane (evidence/r41/hbm_bw/fma_dslx): default-off (tnca_matrix MAC_DP). S2: DP2's shift of the smaller product and the one addition; the other modes' results pass. Combinational.

R41 G2 shared multi-precision MAC lane (evidence/r41/hbm_bw/fma_dslx): default-off (tnca_matrix MAC_DP). F1 = S1 then S2 unregistered (the whole front end; used by the unit screens and the formal proofs). Combinational.

R41 G2 shared multi-precision MAC lane (evidence/r41/hbm_bw/fma_dslx): default-off, not instantiated by the core until the gate passes. F2: |sum|, RO_48 (tree leading-zero count) and the mode's product as an FmaProduct. Combinational.

R41 G2 shared multi-precision MAC lane (evidence/r41/hbm_bw/fma_dslx): default-off, not instantiated by the core until the gate passes. B0: the binary32 FMA's alignment with C (fma32_align_p), mul_only and ftz forced off in the packed modes. Combinational.
